slides.texte_overlay:
What happens when you
stop drinking for a month
Your sleep gets deeper. Many men notice within a week that they wake up more rested and need less coffee to get going.
Your mornings come back. No more lost Sundays. Weekends suddenly have two full days for sport, friends and projects.
You save more than you expect. Drinks, taxis, late-night food. Add it up for a month and the number often surprises people.
Your mood feels more stable. Fewer low days after big nights out. Energy feels more even across the week. Fewer crashes, more calm.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. Clear mornings are perfect for learning something new.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Clear mornings are perfect for learning something new.

slides.texte_overlay: You find out which friendships need a drink. Some evenings get better, some feel strange. Both teach you something useful.
You learn what you actually enjoy. After a month, you decide calmly how much drinking you really want in your life.
